data.content_ref: inline:Add RESIDUE as a fourth derived label that records, for each suspended node, the lexicographically least set of attacking IN-nodes that keep it out; compute it as a pure annotation after the grounded fixed point using a polynomial-time canonical certificate algorithm. This preserves determinism because the fixed point is unchanged and the certificate is canonicalized; it strengthens explainability and gives a constructive witness for every suspension. That witness can later drive a re-examination pass without altering the semantics, and no committed root can be suspended, so committed-root validity is untouched.
